definitions.scope: Use the exponential function relation to determine function values or parameters, solve equations and inequalities, optimize over a stated domain, or model exponential growth or decay in an application context.
definitions.boundary: Use H15-M1-03-EXPONENTIAL_FUNCTION_GRAPH when the decisive demand is interpreting graph shape, transformation, asymptote, intersection, or root geometry. Use H15-M1-01-EXPONENT for power laws or exponent expressions that do not depend on exponential-function behavior.

supportingCurrentStudentExamples.basis: Real-world exponential decay of light intensity with depth.

definitions.scope: Apply logarithmic-function monotonicity, domain, and range to function-value bounds, extrema, inequalities, compositions, discrete solution counts, or function level sets.
definitions.boundary: Use H15-M1-04-LOGARITHMIC_FUNCTION_GRAPH when the decisive demand is graph transformation, asymptote, or graph intersection.
